sources.title: prithivMLmods/Deep-Fake-Detector-v2-Model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Deep-Fake-Detector-v2-Model is a state-of-the-art deep learning model designed to detect deepfake images. It leverages the Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture, specifically the google/vit-base-patch16-224-in21k model, fine-tuned on a dataset of real and deepfake images.

sources.snippet: DeepFake Image Detection 🕵️‍♂️🔍 Welcome to the DeepFake Image Detection repository! This project is designed to detect deepfake images using state-of-the-art deep learning models like VGG16, VGG19, InceptionV3, and ResNet50, combined with an ensemble technique to maximize accuracy.
